# Fake fixture for `jevgate.py score --fake`

`calls.csv`, `ticks.csv`, `outcomes.csv` here are **fabricated** by `make_fixture.py` from a seeded
random walk (year-2000 timestamps, made-up tickers and prices). They are not market data and
say nothing about Kalshi, Jev or any strategy. `.gitignore` lets only these CSVs into git.
